description: Use for a rule-based risk label on an ERC-20 token before you accept or route it: OFAC SDN match, upgradeable proxy, owner with mint/pause/blacklist (USDC, USDT, WBTC, cbBTC issuer-listed). Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /token/risk, $0.01 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For a wallet (not a token contract) use wallet_risk. With a P0 access key (header Authorization: Bearer p0k_…, buy one at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) this tool makes the paid call itself and returns the data, deducting the listed price.
